visualCharacteristics.purpose: Promotional panels with heading, text, link and an illustration below the text
visualCharacteristics.layout: centred panels, illustration rendered below text regardless of cell order; 1 column on mobile, 2 on desktop

contentPattern.structure: One row per promo; cell 1 illustration image, cell 2 heading, paragraph and link

reuseGuidance: Use for cross-promotion tiles (apps, partners, programs) with an illustration.
